title: The Day of the Stubborn Jar Lid
skyStory: The moon has wandered out of Aries and settled into Taurus, ninety-four percent lit and in no hurry whatsoever. Taurus moons love soft blankets, fresh bread and not being rushed. It is a moon with its feet up. Tomorrow it will be full, and it knows it, so tonight it is practising its glow in the mirror, very slowly, by candlelight.

reading: Something today will refuse to budge: a jar lid, a stuck drawer, a file that will not open, a decision that keeps sliding off the table. The Tiger will want to wrestle it. Taurus suggests running it under warm water and waiting.

That goes for people too. Someone will be stubborn about something small. Instead of pushing, ask them a question about it and listen to the whole answer. The lid comes off by itself around 6 pm, figuratively and maybe literally. The [[Knight of Pentacles]] rides slowly and always gets there. Today, so do you, a few minutes late and in excellent spirits.
joel.mission: Do one ordinary task today at exactly half your usual speed, and notice what you see that you normally miss.
joel.omen: A cow, a bull or a picture of one. Steady wins today; the universe has spoken in moos.

reading: Taurus is an earth sign, a cousin of yours, and it has brought you a basket of small comforts. A good pen. A warm sweater from the back of the closet. A window seat that is free when it is usually taken. Take all of it without explaining why you deserve it.

The Mountain is good at holding steady, but today it is allowed to be held. If someone offers to make you a cup of something, say yes before they finish the sentence. If a song comes on that you love, stop what you are doing for the whole of it. Saturn signs off on all of this personally.
nancy.mission: Find the coziest piece of clothing you own and wear it to at least one place it does not belong.
nancy.omen: A dog flopped completely flat on a warm floor. Total surrender is a form of wisdom today.

together.text: Share a list of five small luxuries each, the tiny things that make a day feel rich. A hot water bottle. A clean windshield. The first page of a new book. Compare lists. Steal one item from the other's list and make it happen for yourself tomorrow.
